en: Old black‑and‑white postcard showing a staged scene with numerous people in traditional folk costumes arranged in a theatrical tableau. At the center and right, women in long dresses and men in uniforms and peasant clothing enact an allegorical or historical scene, with props like a spear, drum, zither‑like instrument and tree branches. Along the right side is a vertical printed text block in Finnish, with smaller lines of publication information at the bottom.
